title: QuickGuide
guidance: Preview definitions and decision rules, then close the guide and explain which method applies. Locate the topic-matched QuickGuide on the EG1011 course site.
definition: A concise overview of the topic, key formulas and method-selection rules.

title: Lecture notes and examples
guidance: Cover the worked solution. Attempt the example, explain each equation, then compare your reasoning with the notes.
definition: Read the lecture notes and re-solve the worked examples with the solution covered.

title: T-type tutorial questions
guidance: Attempt topic-matched T-type questions before the tutorial. Mark the exact line or decision to discuss; write your own solution after any help.
definition: Tutorial questions to attempt before class and develop with guidance when needed.

title: H-type independent questions
guidance: Attempt a topic-matched H-type problem without a solution open. Draw the diagram, choose the method, solve, and check units before comparing.
definition: Independent questions to attempt before opening notes, solutions or support materials.

title: Step by Step with Mehdi
guidance: Use the matching Step by Step PDF for the point where your attempt stalled. Predict the next step, then retry the problem with the PDF closed.
definition: PDF support that explains a method one step at a time, followed by your own retry.

title: Interactive exercise app
guidance: Use the topic-matched exercise on the course site. Predict before changing an input; explain the result and test the same idea on paper.
definition: An interactive exercise for testing a concept, prediction or common misconception.

title: Solutions in Action with Mehdi
guidance: Attempt the problem first. Watch only the relevant segment, pause before the next step, then close the video and re-solve that step yourself.
definition: A video walkthrough to compare with your attempt, followed by a closed-video retry.

title: Recall and exit check
guidance: With notes closed, choose the method for a fresh problem, outline the steps and check one result. Record what still needs practice; completion alone does not prove independent skill.
definition: A short closed-book check: choose a method, recall the main steps and reflect on gaps.
